The '''D-24 Inferno Grenade''' was a type of incendiary [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 75 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was restricted to military use but the most ruthless [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] employed it due to the panic it generated.<ref name="DC" />
